description: This Java source file defines the class RetrieveResource, which represents a command for retrieving a Resource based on Policy ID, Label, and Resource Key within a policy management system. It includes methods for constructing instances, creating from JSON, and getting specific attributes of the command.

classes.name: RetrieveResource
classes.description: An immutable command class used to retrieve a resource associated with a specific policy ID, label, and resource key within the policy framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a RetrieveResource command instance with typed PolicyId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveResource instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label associated with the policy entry.

methods.name: getResourceKey
methods.description: Returns the resource key for the resource to retrieve.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the policy ID associated with this command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer path to the targeted resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Builds the JSON payload for the command, including policy ID, label, and resource key.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance with specified headers.
